records.text: More than 275,000 people attended the memorial event across the stadium overflow and Westgate.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: The fact that we were able to pull off an event of a century. ... We had over 275,000 people that attended and stadium overflow, ... Westgate,

verification.notes: Contemporary reporting estimated roughly 90,000 to 100,000 total attendees across the stadium and overflow areas. That is far below the more-than-275,000 figure in the statement.

sources.relevance: Reports an estimated 90,000 to 100,000 attendees, far below the stated 275,000.

records.text: Apparently, Donald Trump had to become personally involved to secure State Farm Stadium for Charlie Kirk's memorial.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep Wjul6YV6izo)

appearances.snippet: Apparently, ... Trump had to get personally involved to secure the Cardinal Stadium.

verification.notes: Trump attended the memorial and the White House supported security and commemoration, but current searches found no reliable source showing that Trump personally intervened in the private stadium booking. The venue operator does not release private contract details.

conveyance.original_source: Text message shown by the email source

records.text: A large and lucrative RV show was scheduled at State Farm Stadium during the weekend of Charlie Kirk's memorial.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep Wjul6YV6izo)

appearances.snippet: which is planning to host a large and lucrative RV show this weekend.

verification.notes: Associated Press reporting before the memorial states the Arizona Cardinals were away that Sunday and that this left State Farm Stadium available for short-notice rental. Searches found no contemporaneous listing, cancellation notice, ticket record, or credible report of a displaced RV show at the stadium that weekend.

sources.relevance: Reports the Cardinals were away and that this left the stadium available for rental on short notice, contradicting a displaced RV show.

records.text: Archived State Farm Stadium calendars showed no RV show scheduled for the weekend of Charlie Kirk's memorial.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I went back on Wayback Machine, ... saved screenshots. ... There was no RV show that was on the calendar for this Cardinal Stadium.

verification.notes: Independent AP reporting corroborates the substantive conclusion that the stadium was available on September 21, 2025, and searches found no RV-show listing for that weekend. However, the specific archived-calendar screenshots cited by Owens were not publicly retrievable, so the archival-inspection claim itself could not be directly authenticated.

sources.title: What to know about State Farm Stadium, the venue hosting Charlie Kirk's memorial service Sunday - Associated Press
sources.relevance: Independently corroborates that the stadium was available that weekend, though it does not authenticate Owens's archived screenshots.

records.text: Geotagging partners tracked more than 277,000 devices near State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Arizona.
records.speaker: Andrew Kolvet

appearances.snippet: our partners that do sort of geotagging with devices, they told us that they tracked over 277,000 devices in the vicinity of State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Arizona.

verification.notes: The transcript presents this as Andrew Kolvet's public report. A contemporaneous report confirms Kolvet said technology partners tracked 277,000 devices at the memorial; it verifies his attributed statement, but does not independently audit the underlying device count.
